title: 3D Asset Server 作例・解説動画
message: Web用の木箱を、探して、容量を見てから、実物まで持ってくる（探す → 容量 → 取得 → 3D）
operation: 原典の AssetService.search で「wooden crate」を model・無料・3件で探し、候補と配信元ごとの状態（Poly Haven は ok、Fab は link）を見る（A01）
原典の getAsset で CC0・作者・形式を見て、Web の three.js 向けに glTF を選ぶ（A02）
原典の selectFiles・totalBytes・expandFiles で、取得の前に 1k の glTF 一式の全ファイルと合計を出す（A03）
8k の一式を予算 4,194,304 バイトで原典の downloadFiles に渡し、取得の通信0件で止まることを見る（A04）
1k の5ファイルを原典の downloadFiles で取得し、大きさと MD5 を Poly Haven の files API の値と照らす（A08）
閲覧ページで、照合済みの5ファイルを three 0.180.0 の GLTFLoader で読み、取得した実物を3Dで見る
audience: Web や three.js の小さなシーンに既にある3D素材を入れたい日本語の制作者と、素材探しをエージェントに任せる前に、利用条件と容量の確かめ方を知りたい人
next_action: 作例ページ（../index.html#A08）で取得した木箱を回して見て、A04 の予算超過の原典の例外と A01 の候補を読み、5ファイルの ZIP と記録の JSON を保存する

output.orientation: landscape authored at 1280×720. window.renderConfig sizes are honoured at initialisation: the backing store is the requested size, the logical frame widens or heightens to the requested aspect so the masthead and footer sit on the real edges, and the 1280×720 content block is centred and drawn natively. No separate portrait or square composition is authored or claimed.

authorship.film_code_and_japanese_copy: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) wrote index.html, video.css, video.js, storyboard.json and README.md in this folder. This authoring step is separate from the runtime: no model ran inside the original API calls, the downloads or the checks, and the film draws only saved values.
authorship.inputs: input/asset-requests.json (eight operations A01–A08, providers polyhaven and fab, budget 4194304 bytes, identifying User-Agent) and input/expected.json were fixed by the Studio Yebisu production side before execution.
authorship.execution: The production side ran run.mjs with Node 24.18.0 against the live Poly Haven API and CDN. Values in the record were returned by the unmodified 3D Asset Server 0.1.0 functions compiled by the original build:server (AssetService.search, getAsset, selectFiles, totalBytes, expandFiles, downloadFiles) — not by a model. Fab is link-only and was not contacted.
authorship.model: Wooden Crate 01 is by James Ray Cock, distributed by Poly Haven under CC0. Neither the tool nor Claude Opus 5.5 created the 3D model; the tool finds and downloads existing assets.
authorship.screenshots: video/assets/phone.jpg and desktop.jpg are unedited native Chromium JPEG screenshots of the Studio Yebisu viewer page (its own three 0.180.0 GLTFLoader viewer, not the full upstream app), captured by the production side (screens.json): phone at the default angle, desktop after pressing the native 右へ回す button twice.

manifest.rule: video.js hashes the manifest bytes first, then requires its format (studio-yebisu-assetserver-film-assets-v1), source_commit and the eight path/sha256/bytes entries to equal the values frozen in video.js before using anything else.

files.role: public actual run record: pinned upstream f605df3 and 115 vendor files, eight inputs and the values or original errors each returned, 8 real HTTP requests (3 API + 5 CDN), the five downloaded files with bytes, SHA-256 and MD5 against Poly Haven's files API, glTF 2.0 references and counts, 39 runner checks, summary
212 independent production-side Python checks: vendor bytes against Git blobs, pre-execution Poly Haven sizes and MD5, actual glTF binary accessors (3 meshes, 6576 triangles, 4686 vertices)

29 checks of an explicitly offline replay: a new Node process ran the unmodified original APIs on the 8 captured real responses, 0 external calls, all five files byte-identical. Not a second live provider query; search tookMs excluded
frozen input; every record input must equal it; providers, budget and User-Agent
pinned upstream arielshad/3d-asset-server f605df3 (0.1.0, Apache-2.0): 58 original files, 50 original build:server outputs, 7 three 0.180.0 files

sources.fetch_rule: Same-origin fetch of assets/<name> relative to document.baseURI with response.ok required. Missing file, HTTP error, invalid UTF-8 or JSON, byte length or SHA-256 mismatch, a different pinned commit/version/license, vendor lock count or kinds, three pin, input, per-operation input, network hosts or counts, chosen asset, licence or credit, A01 candidates and provider states, A02 details, A03 selection and total, A04 budget, error text and no-request observations, A05/A06 error names, A07 skipped, A08 manifest/MD5/SHA-256/network/selection agreement, glTF references and counts, runner, independent or replay checks, screenshot provenance, JPEG start/end markers, JPEG header size, decoded dimensions or a crop outside the image rejects window.motionReady. No embedded fallback or substitute image; the screenshots' RGB hashes are carried as provenance and are not recomputed in the browser because JPEG decoders may differ.

upstream.skill: web/src/content/SKILL.md (search → inspect licence, format and complete size → download)

sources.asset_credit: Wooden Crate 01 by James Ray Cock / Poly Haven / CC0 — https://polyhaven.com/a/wooden_crate_01 (attribution not required; shown anyway)

scope.shown: Real unmodified 3D Asset Server functions on the live Poly Haven API with two providers enabled: short search → licence and formats → complete size before download → budget refusal before any request → actual download of the five-file 1k glTF set → byte, MD5 and glTF checks → the actual files drawn by the Studio Yebisu viewer's three 0.180.0 GLTFLoader.
not_shown_or_claimed: all providers the upstream supports (only Poly Haven via API and Fab as link-only; Fab was not contacted)
new AI 3D generation; the crate is an existing CC0 model by James Ray Cock, not made by the tool or by Claude Opus 5.5
the hosted server 3d.shep.bot, the HTTP API (serve), the MCP transport, the upstream web app, accounts, API keys or paid assets
Blender, game engines or a production site
a live agent: the editor and the film read saved results; nothing is searched or downloaded when they open
a second live query or identical live timing: the replay check used captured responses offline; tookMs and ranking can change on re-run
visual quality or production performance (only file identity and glTF structure were checked)
8 models: 8 is the number of operations; 5 is the number of files of 1 model
a turntable or generated rotation: the two angles are two native screenshots (default angle; two presses of 右へ回す)
continuous screen recording, a terminal, chat, progress bar or simulated run (the budget bars are labelled as a size diagram)
upstream logos, Poly Haven thumbnails or other remote images
physical iPhone Safari, VoiceOver or human approval
scope.excluded_from_screen: No fake terminal, chat, progress or invented UI; no remote thumbnails; no full hashes on film (they are listed in the editor's #asset-checks and here); English paths and the raw original error appear only as smaller supplemental lines next to the Japanese reading.

design.phone_reading: A 360px-wide MP4 scales by 0.28: headlines ≈ 20–25px, primary lines ≈ 15px, labels ≈ 13px. Paths, the raw English error and captions are supplemental at that width; the main message (探す → 容量 → 取得 → 3D, 2.17 MiB vs 113.14 MiB, 5ファイル, the crate) stays legible. The viewer keeps the full text.

framing.desktopCrate: desktop.jpg source rect x 250, y 500, w 360, h 300 — inside the viewer's 3D panel around the crate
framing.rule: Crops are drawn with drawImage from the verified decoded image, scaled only (scene 1 ×1.44, scene 5 ×1.80 phone and ×1.31 desktop, scene 6 ×1.06 phone). No filter, colour change, retouch or re-encode; the frame shadow is drawn behind the image. The rectangles are constants in video.js FRAMING and are checked to lie inside the decoded image.

design.labels: Screenshots are captioned 閲覧ページの実画面（3D表示部を切り抜き）. File-format tags (glTF / BIN / JPG) and the budget bars are explanatory graphics; the bars are captioned as a size diagram, not download progress. Candidate rows are text from the record, without thumbnails.
persistent: 6px charcoal top bar; masthead 3D Asset Server ・ Web用の3D素材を探して取得する; step rail 探す / 容量 / 取得 / 3D with the current step underlined in orange (none in scene 1, all four in scene 6)
footer: 保存した実行記録と閲覧ページの実画面から描いた映像 ・ 無音; arielshad/3d-asset-server f605df3
design.motion: Ease-out fades and short rises computed from absolute time; candidate rows slide in; budget bars extend once as a diagram with a scale break on the 8k bar and a stop mark at the budget line; file rows slide in and get a green check each. Scenes dip to paper over 0.35 s between them; scene 1 is fully visible at frame 0.

contract.canvas: getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }); backing store equals renderConfig width × height; logical frame max(1280, 720·W/H) × max(720, 1280·H/W) scaled to the backing store, content block 1280×720 centred; CSS scales the 16:9 canvas in the editor
contract.seek: window.seek(seconds) clamps to 0..28, records it as the selected time and returns a Promise that resolves after the requested frame is drawn from absolute time and the verified assets only; any order gives the same frame; no frame depends on earlier frames, wall clock, randomness or CSS animation
contract.ready: window.motionReady resolves only after the manifest and the eight files match SHA-256 and byte length over HTTP (response.ok), all record invariants pass (commit f605df3, 8 operations, 39 checks, summary 1 model / 5 files / 2,277,087 bytes, 8 requests), both original JPEGs match markers, header size and decoded size (360×780, 1265×889), images are decoded and document.fonts.ready settles; otherwise it rejects with the concrete reason, the canvas is cleared and hidden, controls are disabled and #retry re-fetches everything (one load at a time)
contract.export_mode: window.__MOTION_RENDER__ === true: editor chrome hidden, canvas only at exact size, no requestAnimationFrame preview and no autoplay
contract.preview: Starts stopped at 0, no autoplay. #play toggles 再生/一時停止 (aria-pressed); #time (range 0–28 step 0.1) seeks on input, change and Enter; #reset returns to the last selected time (a seek to 14 stays at 14); scene buttons carry data-time and seek to a reading moment; #clock shows the current time and state (no fixed 0 banner); #status says what was checked; #loading is shown only while loading; #asset-checks lists all eight rows with 一致 / 不一致 / 照合前 and full hashes; #editor[data-state] is loading, ready or error; after a retry the editor is stopped at 0 s (no resume)
